items.t: Roadster rear window comes unglued and falls out
items.job: Rebond the rear window or replace the convertible top
items.note: Owners report about $1,500–$3,000 for a full top; a rebond, when possible, costs far less.
If the cam sensor or relay module is at fault, the cost changes.

items.t: Key won't turn or sticks in the ignition
items.job: Replace ignition switch and lock housing
items.note: If a new key and lock cylinder are needed, owners report bills of $800–$1,400.

items.t: Anti-theft module failure stops the car from starting
items.job: Replace and program the anti-theft (SKREEM) module
items.note: CarComplaints lists a typical cost of about $1,400 for the alarm no-start problem.

items.t: Alternator overcharges and ruins the battery
Convertible top stops working or drops on its own
items.job: Repair the power top system or replace the top
items.note: One owner was quoted about $1,900 for a complete top.

items.t: Brake lights stop working with a brake assist warning
Takata driver airbag inflator can rupture (recall 16V-081)
items.job: Replace driver airbag inflator under recall
items.note: Free at a dealer if not already done.

items.t: A/C and heater blower cuts out or stops
items.job: Replace blower motor or its control
items.note: Owners report $1,200–$2,200 when several parts were replaced.
CarComplaints' typical figure of about $2,200 included other work.

items.t: Turn signal quits from a shorting bulb socket
items.job: Repair or replace the turn signal bulb socket
items.note: CarComplaints lists a typical cost of about $430.
CarComplaints lists a typical cost of about $200.

items.t: Rear sway bar brackets break loose
items.job: Weld in new rear sway bar brackets
items.note: CarComplaints lists a typical cost of about $2,800.
